_ghi_chu: gpu51: 10 tiếng nền theo TÌNH HUỐNG hiệu ứng thẻ (FXR, www/js/13-fxr.js). Tạo: node tools/tao_sfx_elevenlabs.mjs <thư_mục_thô> --ds=sfx_fx_ds.json --ngan-sach=600 --per-sec=20; ghép: python3 tools/sfx_fx_build.py <thư_mục_thô> www/sfx (-> fx.mp3 + fx.json, một sprite). Lớp nhấn theo hệ dùng e_<hệ> có sẵn trong sfx3.

list.dung: +sức mạnh cho thẻ khác (luồng sáng tới đích)
list.t: fantasy card game power-up blessing: a bright rising shimmering magical whoosh that lands on a soft warm bronze bell chime, ascending pitch, clean and full mid-range, no harsh high frequencies
fantasy card game curse debuff: a short heavy downward whip lash followed by a dull cracking stone fracture, descending pitch, dark and punchy mid-range, not shrill

list.dung: +/- năng lượng, giá thẻ (đồng hồ, ngọc năng lượng)
list.t: fantasy game mana energy gain: two quick brass clock ticks followed by a soft glowing magical charge-up hum and a small crystal gem sparkle, warm and short

list.dung: ủng hộ / hồi (trái tim, Duy Trì)
list.t: fantasy card game healing support: a soft warm double heartbeat thump with a gentle glowing magical shimmer swell, comforting, low-mid warm tone, no harsh highs
fantasy card game card destroyed: a sharp punchy shattering crunch of breaking stone and thick glass with short debris scatter, strong impact, mid-range, no shrill ringing tail

list.dung: vứt bỏ (giấy cháy bay về chồng bỏ)
list.t: fantasy card game discard: a quick whoosh of fire igniting a paper card with a short crackling burn and a soft ember puff, short and clean

list.dung: kích hoạt (ấn chú xoay dưới chân thẻ)
list.t: fantasy card game rune activation: a mystical stone seal clicking into place with a resonant low magical pulse and a brief swirling hum, mid-range, not piercing

list.dung: triệu hồi / tạo thẻ (cổng ấn mở)
list.t: fantasy card game summoning portal opening: a deep magical swirling whoosh rising into a soft bronze drum boom as a creature appears, warm mid-range

list.dung: hồi sinh (sen linh hồn trồi lên)
list.t: fantasy card game spirit resurrection: an ethereal rising airy magical swell with a soft bloom of warm light and a gentle low hum, smooth, no shrill highs
fantasy card game magic shield block: a solid bronze shield clang with a short magical barrier hum, deflecting hit, mid-range, not piercing
